summary: Web app with existing user/admin dashboard where clicking Get Started fails due to missing Internet Computer backend canister configuration; user wants errors fixed (including ordering placement issues) and a build that can be hosted on cPanel as a static site with an index.html.
architectural_notes: Frontend relies on Internet Computer backend canister principal ID provided via VITE_BACKEND_CANISTER_ID; production deployments must inject this value before the app can connect.
Need a downloadable static build (index.html + assets) compatible with standard web hosting (cPanel), not just platform deployment.
known_issues: Production build misconfigured: VITE_BACKEND_CANISTER_ID not set, causing Get Started/dashboard connectivity failure and blocking backend-dependent flows (including ordering).

existing_features.title: Add a runtime-config fallback for the backend canister ID so the app can be hosted as a static site (e.g., on cPanel) without requiring build-time injection, while preserving the existing current behavior when VITE_BACKEND_CANISTER_ID is correctly set at build time.

Create a cPanel-friendly static deployment bundle and documentation: ensure the production build output includes an index.html entry point and all required assets, and add clear steps for uploading to cPanel including SPA routing configuration (refreshing deep links like /dashboard should work).

Fix the dashboard/admin-dashboard flows so authenticated users can reach the dashboard via the Get Started flow and place orders without being blocked by configuration errors when properly configured; keep the current design and behavior unchanged except for error fixes.

Improve the deployment scripts/docs so that when deploying to the Internet Computer, the build reliably injects VITE_BACKEND_CANISTER_ID (retrieving it via dfx when available), and the failure mode is actionable; do not hardcode canister IDs into version control.

new_feature_requests.summary: Fix deployment/config so VITE_BACKEND_CANISTER_ID is set/injected (detect existing backend canister ID if present, otherwise set up a backend canister) and redeploy so dashboard Get Started connects successfully.
Provide a static-site build output suitable for cPanel hosting, including an index.html entry point (and necessary assets) so user can download and self-host the website.
Fix dashboard/admin dashboard issues preventing users from placing orders ("ordering placing" errors) while keeping current design and behavior.

projectName: Fix backend canister ID misconfiguration and enable static cPanel hosting build
